mission.name: Runner's weekly log
mission.intendedUsers: Club runners who log about three runs a week on their phone, often with no signal on the trail.
mission.outcome: A runner opens the app and sees this week's distance against the plan they set, including runs logged offline.
successCriteria: The weekly total shows within a second of opening the app.
A run logged offline is in the total once the phone is back online, never twice.
constraints: Works offline: logging a run never needs a connection.
No account is needed to log a run.

tasks.title: Weekly total against the plan
tasks.goal: Show this week's total distance next to the weekly target the runner set.
acceptanceCriteria: The total and the target show on the home screen.
tasks.scope: The home screen's total and target.
assumptions: Runs are already stored on the phone.

tasks.title: Sync runs logged offline
tasks.goal: Send runs logged offline to the server once the phone is online again.
acceptanceCriteria: A run logged offline reaches the server after reconnecting.
assumptions: The server accepts a run more than once without harm.

tasks.title: Set a weekly target
tasks.goal: Let the runner set a weekly distance target.
acceptanceCriteria: The target can be set and changed in settings.
tasks.scope: A settings field for the target.
